note: Subject layer of variant B of the robed cultists' round 2 (bead pulp_wars-mch9.54): fresh creations of ordinary people with visible faces, evil in their robes and props. Exploration only.

subjects.UNIT:CULT:FIGHTER/BLACK: Subject: Initiate, a chunky shifty young man, a novice of an evil secret society and the smallest figure: a plain black hooded robe with a blood-red lining inside the hood, a blood-red rope belt and a ragged pointed hem down to his boots; the hood is up but his pale human face is clearly visible, with narrow suspicious eyes, a nasty smirk and dark stubble; one hand raises a curved sacrificial dagger whose steel blade is smeared with bright red blood, the other holds a short cream candle with a small green flame; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:GUARD/BLACK: Subject: Idol Bearer, a chunky stout broad-shouldered bald man with a heavy grim scowling face, the widest and squarest figure: a long black robe with heavy iron chains crossed over the chest and a blood-red sash; both arms are raised and hold over his head one squat pale grey stone idol head as big as his own head, with a wide evil toothy grin and two small green eyes; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:MARKSMAN/BLACK: Subject: Hexer, a chunky sly woman of an evil secret society: a long deep purple robe with blood-red trim and gold occult sigils and a black cowl over her dark hair, her pale face clearly visible with a cruel smug smile and narrowed eyes; one hand holds up an open black-bound ritual book, the other hand is thrust forward with one small green spark of a curse leaving her fingers; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:CAPTAIN/BLACK: Subject: Summoner, the high priest of an evil secret society, the tallest and thinnest figure: a narrow ornate ceremonial robe of deep blood red with gold embroidered sigils, a black mantle and a very tall pointed blood-red cowl; his gaunt face is pallid grey-white with dark veins round the eyes and one milky white eye; one hand raises a long ornate ritual dagger, its steel blade dripping bright red blood, and a black iron chain hangs from the other hand; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:CULT:CATAPULT/BLACK: Subject: Stargazer, a crooked old astrologer of an evil secret society at a big brass telescope: a long charcoal-black robe embroidered with gold stars and a black hood lined with blood red; his wrinkled pale face is pressed to the eyepiece of one fat polished brass telescope on a wooden tripod, the tube pointing up to the right; a cream star chart scroll trails on the ground; the telescope glass is dark, not glowing; simple shapes and very few details.
